title: Replace mandatory planet node expansion with indexed PBF lookups
description: User wants to avoid the ~167.6 GB planet_nodes.bin intermediate, potentially processing/discarding chunks. Current Build All expands every source node to 16-byte id/lat/lon records; nodes can be referenced by later ways, so use-once deletion is unsafe. Proposed replacement: scan original PBF once to persist node-ID ranges and compressed block offsets, validate ordering/source identity, and resolve batched way dependencies from original compressed blocks through a bounded decoded-block cache. Existing osmpbf 0.2.8 BlobReader supports seekable_from_path/blob_from_offset; its IndexedReader also demonstrates block ID-range indexing. Keep original PBF during building; evict decoded blocks without deleting the sole remaining source. Benchmark index size/startup, cold/warm lookup throughput, memory and end-to-end build time before making it default. Verify exact geometry/feature parity, boundary/shared nodes, missing IDs, out-of-order inputs, stale index detection and durable source-aware resume. Do not delete or rewrite existing node stores/checkpoints during implementation; existing flat-store builds need explicit compatible migration/reset. Regional dependency-complete builds are a fallback, with extra source scans and boundary duplication. No implementation or cleanup has been performed for this proposal.
notes: Implemented optional indexed-PBF storage in CLI/Full Planet GUI. Resumable SQLite block descriptors + original-PBF coordinate reads; per-session 16 MiB LRU plus bounded grouped way-reference prefetch. Isolated indexed-pbf-v1 state, OS lock, source identity/settings binding; existing flat files/checkpoints preserved. All-feature exact normalized parity across 3 Hilbert extracts, 3 runs/mode: CA 17.97MB -> 12.36KB scratch, median 0.20s -> 0.22s; Delhi 88.67MB -> 36.94KB, 1.35s -> 3.45s; Colombia 45.02MB -> 24.65KB, 0.72s -> 2.07s. Grouping improved initial Delhi compact 8.85s to 3.45s. Compact trades disk for CPU/RAM; remains opt-in. docs/compact-node-lookup.md and disposable benchmark script reproduce results. Source on Hilbert, outputs/internal temp, OS caches not purged; no full-planet forecast/job. Workspace tests pass; added source/index corruption, interrupted scan resume, lock, prefetch eviction/limits, ordinary+dense full output/legacy preservation tests. Default-promotion/planet-scale performance follow-up 1kee-7o5; pre-existing output durability 1kee-0ke stays open.
